# Generated by mods/where_to_produce/tools/generate.py. Do not edit by hand.

# **The country is saved, not reached for.** Every method's availability is a
# country trigger asked from inside a walk over locations, and it used to get
# there with `root`. From a Mod Menu button `root` is the country; from a map
# picker's generic action it is not, so the eleventh run's pass walked its
# 44 locations, found no method available in any of them -- «нашёл 0» -- and the
# window emptied itself the moment a border was drawn.
#
# Scope: country

	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_show value = var:bag_wtp_best_method }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_show = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_show value = var:bag_wtp_any_best_method }
	}
	clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_goods
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_bt
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_pm
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_pm2
	# Zeroed rather than left: nothing sets these where no method won at all, the
	# window guards only on `_bt`, and a number left over from the last run is
	# invisible there and wrong to everything that reads it.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_bonus value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_out value = 0 }

	# Zeroed rather than left: nothing sets these where no method won at all, the

# What stands once every advance is in, on the built-up side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_winner_end_town = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_show value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_show = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_show value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method }
	}
	clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_end_goods
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_end_bt
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_end_pm
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_end_pm2
	# Zeroed rather than left: nothing sets these where no method won at all, the
	# window guards only on `_bt`, and a number left over from the last run is
	# invisible there and wrong to everything that reads it.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_bonus value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_out value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_goods_all value = 0 }

		limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_show = 16 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_bt value = building_type:brewery_mill }

			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }

			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:wheat } } }

# What stands once every advance is in, on the village side.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_winner_end_rural = {
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_show_rural value = var:bag_wtp_end_best_method_rural }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_show_rural = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_show_rural value = var:bag_wtp_end_any_best_method_rural }
	}
	clear_variable_list = bag_wtp_end_goods_rural
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_end_bt_rural
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_end_pm_rural
	remove_variable = bag_wtp_end_pm2_rural
	# Zeroed rather than left: nothing sets these where no method won at all, the
	# window guards only on `_bt`, and a number left over from the last run is
	# invisible there and wrong to everything that reads it.
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_bonus_rural value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_out_rural value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_goods_all_rural value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:bag_wtp_end_show_rural = 17 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_bt_rural value = building_type:market_village }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_pm_rural value = production_method:rural_millet_brewery }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_bonus_rural value = bag_wtp_b17 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_out_rural value = 0.5000 }
		set_variable = { name = bag_wtp_end_goods_all_rural value = 2 }
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:lumber } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_end_goods_rural target = goods:lumber }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { province_definition = { any_location_in_province_definition = { raw_material = goods:millet } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = bag_wtp_end_goods_rural target = goods:millet }
